system.description: With the expenditure of two Mental Traits, you can walk into one shadow and exit from another up to 50 feet away, acting as a limited form of teleportation to bypass solid walls, ascend a floor, or get around other obstacles. You may attempt to pull others through a shadow by reaching in, grabbing the victim, and pulling her through to your location (requiring a Physical Challenge). You may carry objects (including living creatures) through the shadows. Use of this power requires you to state which shadow you wish to step through, walk over that shadow, then exit from the stated shadow and resume play. Use of this power is a Fair Escape.
